page.overview:
Who is Pamela Strode?

Pamela Strode is a minor character that only appears in .

Pamela Strode was Morgan Strode's wife and Laurie Strode's mother (adoptive mother in timelines that include Halloween II).

The following information is only relevant to the 4-6 and H20 Timelines.

At some point when Laurie was young, Pamela possibly revealed to her that she was not her real mother. It does seem that Laurie forgot about this information as she became older and only remembered it in a shock-induced dream following the events of October 31, 1978.
